# ob-04 — Replace or redesign deterministic-token cryptography

Retain deterministic token functionality while removing the documented prefix leakage. Have the design reviewed; evaluate a vetted FLOSS package if the .NET BCL cannot meet the security requirement, and record manifest/API compatibility and migration behavior.

**Findings:** README.md documents fixed-IV CBC prefix leakage; Obfuscator/ObfuscationEngine.cs (was S04) · **Size:** L · **Tree:** core,tests

**2026-10-07** — Decisions (owner-approved 2026-10-07): Algorithm = AES-SIV-CMAC-256 (RFC 5297; two AES-128 keys), implemented in-repo in Obfuscator/AesSiv.cs on BCL Aes.EncryptEcb; a .NET 10.0.12 probe found no public CMAC/SIV type in the BCL. No new dependency. Token = OBF_TK2_ + base64url(SIV||CTR ciphertext) over UTF-8 + PKCS7 padding to 16 bytes (length leak unchanged from CBC). Per-column key = HKDF(master, '<column>|token-siv', 32); AD = column name. Joinability scope unchanged: per column, per manifest salt. Compatibility: manifest Version 2.1, ColumnObfuscationSpec.TokenScheme='aes-siv-cmac-256/v1' (omitted when null so 2.0 checksums verify); TokenScheme null => legacy OBF_TKN_ CBC decrypt-only path, CBC encrypt removed. Unknown scheme throws. Public API signatures unchanged.

**Not in this slice:**

## Why

The current deterministic-token implementation uses AES-CBC with a fixed per-column IV. The project README documents prefix leakage for related fixed-width values.

## Files

Obfuscator/ObfuscationEngine.cs; Obfuscator/Models.cs; Obfuscator/Obfuscator.csproj; Obfuscator.Tests/ObfuscatorTests.cs; all manifest format documentation.

## Failing tests

Add tests for deterministic equality within the intended scope, distinct values, cross-column separation, deobfuscation, tampered tokens, and compatibility behavior for existing manifests.

## Implement

After ob-01 fixes the security contract, choose and review a deterministic, misuse-resistant construction. Use a vetted FLOSS package if the BCL cannot meet the requirement; document license and maintenance cost. Version any changed manifest/API behavior and specify how existing data is restored or migrated.

## Check

Run cryptographic known-answer or interoperability vectors supplied by the selected design, focused token tests, and the full solution test suite on supported platforms. Review that equal inputs remain joinable only within the documented scope.

## Git

Never claim a custom construction is secure solely because round-trip tests pass. Record algorithm, dependency, and compatibility decisions.
